ShortDescription.Value: Connect Cities: Skylines II to local MCP agents for city inspection and construction. Windows; companion server required.

Publish.LongDescription:
CityWeaver connects Cities: Skylines II to compatible local AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It supports live city inspection, planning, native construction previews, and supported building workflows.
IMPORTANT: This download contains only the in-game bridge. To use it, you also need the separate CityWeaverMCP Node.js server and an MCP-compatible agent on the same Windows PC. The mod does not include an AI client or add standalone in-game construction controls. See the linked GitHub project for the server, installation steps, example prompts, and troubleshooting.
Getting started: enable the mod, install Node.js 20 or newer and the companion MCP server, configure your agent to launch its server.mjs as a local STDIO MCP server, then load a playable city and ask the agent to check get_game_status. The agent can handle most setup if it has local command and configuration access.
The bridge listens only on 127.0.0.1 and generates a fresh authentication token when it starts. Do not share the connection file or token. Construction can change your city and spend in-game funds; back up important saves first. Not every tool or map has completed in-game validation. Supported platform: Windows.

ChangeLog.Value: Version 1.24.4 adds Fishing Line work-route discovery, preview, creation and deletion through MCP. Expired previews now report expired immediately and cannot be committed; capability discovery lists all work-route tools. Route previews are conservative preflights: verify boat dispatch and pathing after construction. Tested with Cities: Skylines II 1.6.2f1 on Windows. The separate MCP server is still required.
